name: Detect Evil & Good
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You sense the presence of any deities, spirits and undead. For each of these that is within...

  • Far range, you just sense its presence.

  • Long range, you sense its presence and whether its Alignment is evil, neutral or good.

  • Medium range, you know its location and its full Alignment.

  • Short Range, you know its location, full Alignment and Domain.

You also detect whether any creatures within Short Range are currently under any effects imposed by a deity, spirit or undead.

This sense is blocked by barriers of metal of any thickness, barriers of stone at least 1 ft thick, or barriers of any solid material at least 3 ft thick.

Describe how you sense these entities.

improvements.name: Dispel Evil & Good
improvements.description:
While you have this sense active, attack rolls made against you by deities, spirits and undead are ill-favored. Additionally, you may spend an action and 5 MP to trigger one of the following effects:

  • Dispel. You touch a creature and immediately end all effects imposed upon that creature by a deity, spirit or undead.

  • Dismissal. Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a deity, spirit or undead. On a win, it returns to the center of its Domain (if any) or moves until it is outside of far range from you - whichever is further. Either way, it cannot come within far range of you for 1 day. On a loss, it cannot move closer to you for 1 round.

If you trigger either of these effects, the spell ends.
